comments.mergedPostDetails:
Currently there does not seem to be any entry in the Group's Audit Log when a group member with instance moderation uses their power to kick someone from an instance. This means that the group owner/management can't correctly determine if a group member is abusing their moderation powers.

Simple request: If a group member with instance moderation powers kick a user from any Group (GP, G+, G) instance, add a log entry to the Group's Audit Log with the name of the kicker and kickee.

I doubt it is necessary to log the use of the Warn or Force Mic Off moderation powers.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Audit Log Entry when Kicking with Group Moderation

comments.mergedPostDetails:
Group Logs should show who was kicked from the instance and who kicked them!

Missing this information causes an incredible amount of unnecessary drama.

If we could simply see who done it there would be a lot less detective work, finger pointing, and false accusations.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Group logs need to show kickers and kicked!

comments.value: Dustuu & all, see my post below in reply to 'Sigma Wolf'
An API change has been deployed which adds kick and warn actions in Group instances to the Group Audit Log, including who the action was on, and who initiated it. Enjoy!

details:
Right now, the only moderation action that seems to appear in the Group Audit Log is when a user is banned from a Group. It would be great to be able to see more moderation actions in this log, such as when a user is kicked from a Group Instance by someone with Group moderation permissions.

This could be very helpful for deterring misuse of Group moderation permissions.
